occlusionLine.note: Walkway parapet — SOLID CONCRETE, not balusters. Doubles as the wall Jay sits on in s1d6_sat and as the balustrade in the landing nodes. Balusters fail continuous occlusion by construction.

scene.block.note: 16 nodes, the highest-traffic asset in the district. One deck-access exterior: front doors along one side, the drop and the rail along the other, shopfronts across the walkway. Absorbs the landings (D2), the shops, the wall and the long walk home. Serves both s1d2_plate (the PLAYER's landing) and s1d4_open/_landing (Jay's) — same drawn architecture, different doors.

occlusionLine.note: Counter top. scene.kitchen precedent — the one environment that satisfied the contract by accident because the counter was designed before the figure.
Sofa back plus sideboard, BOTH boxed to the floor. A sofa is the shape most likely to be drawn with legs, and legs are the 2B.6 P0.

scene.jay_frontroom.note: Day 4 only. Must read through to the kitchen doorway — Day 4's design is the player watching the evening happen through two doorways without him.

scene.jay_kitchen.note: Two nodes whose branches differ in DRESSING as well as light: Friday's party against Sunday afternoon. The only scene where data-time carries more than atmosphere.

occlusionLine.note: EXEMPT — see note. Both nodes are empty-cast.

scene.bedroom.note: EXEMPT from the y=600 occlusion rule. Both nodes (s1d1_alone, s1d6_afternoon) are empty-cast and resolve to `absent`: no figure, no hands at y=600, nothing to occlude. The only exempt scene in the district — do not generalise it.

occlusionLine.note: Kerb wall around the pitch, or kit bags. THE MESH FENCE DOES NOT OCCLUDE — it is transparent and will fail the alpha test while looking like a barrier.

scene.cage.note: Floodlit Tuesday evening, daylight trial Saturday morning.

occlusionLine.note: HIGHEST RISK IN THE SET. A hallway has no natural waist-height solid. Use a built-in — low bookcase or boxed meter cupboard, floor to y<600, no legs and no open span. DO NOT USE A CONSOLE TABLE: that is precisely what failed in scene.flat_hallway.

scene.jay_hallway.note: One node, s1d4_photos. The photographs are architecture, not props.

occlusionLine.note: Balcony parapet — CONCRETE, not railings. Railings fail by construction.

scene.jay_balcony.note: One node. The threshold, with cold spill from outside against the room's amber.

occlusionLine.note: Lockers or a fixed bench, boxed to the floor.

scene.bus_stop.note: Day 2's decision. Not on the estate — the route home from Jay's aunt's.
